newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: INSIGHT-Australian 10-yr bond nudges on the rally.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-Australian 10-yr bond nudges on the rally.

text.p: *The Australian 10-year bond futures contract ended a tightly traded SYCOM session attempting to make a clean break of 93.280 resistance.
*June labour force data due at 11.30 a.m. (0130 GMT), employment seen up 40,250, unemployment rate at 8.7 percent.
The September Australian 10-year bond futures contract ended a tightly traded SYCOM session attempting to make a clean break of 93.280 resistance.
The contract ended after hours trade at 93.285, up from Wednesday's 93.275 close and having made a new 3-1/2 year high of 93.295 at one stage.

Confirmation of a break of 93.280 in dayside trade is expected to find further resistance at 93.310 and then 93.360, while moves to the downside should find initial support at around 93.200 to 93.180, analysts said.
A resumption in the U.S. Treasury market's rally on Wednesday helped to underpin local futures contracts, although trade remained light ahead of the June labour force report at 11.30 a.m. (0130 GMT).

Median forecasts centre on an employment rise of 40,250, virtually wiping out the 40,300 fall in May, while the unemployment rate is seen at 8.7 percent and down from 8.8 percent, according to a Reuters survey of economists.
While employment is expected to rebound, economists say it would take a much stronger outcome than forecast to alter hopes of a further monetary policy easing.
